design: Outcome-blind preregistration for FCLR-LIQ-RISK-ESCALATION-09: the first confirmatory use of the on-disk ironflow bulk observed-liquidation stream (Track A, RESEARCH_PROMPT.md section 3.2) to test whether funding-conditioned features predict observed liquidation intensity. NOT a re-run of the modeled Track B breach proxy. The funding-conditioned VOLATILITY (QLIKE) pillar is already closed leakage-robust null (FCLR-POOLED-ROBUST-002: C2-B1 QLIKE +1.011%, Holm primary p=0.6365 vs alpha_2=0.00833), so this Track A observed-liquidation-intensity question is the single highest-value unfinished work. No risk overlay (RESEARCH_PROMPT.md section 9: forecast gate did not pass). All artifacts under research_state/session_20261122T224500Z/ only; root md+json cap 499/500 respected.
data: research_state/data_cache/ironflow_bulk/{candles_1h,funding,open_interest,liquidations}, 18 months 2025-05..2026-10, .parquet.sha256 asserted before every read, caches read-only, no network, no new source
context: FCLR-POOLED-001 (session_20261122T092003Z): NOT_SUPPORTED, funding features add ~0.0% QLIKE vs RV-only. FCLR-POOLED-AUDIT-001 (session_20261122T165200Z): found leakage/quality gaps. FCLR-POOLED-ROBUST-002 (session_20261122T190000Z): NOT_SUPPORTED_LEAKAGE_ROBUST_NULL, all remediations applied, null confirmed leakage-robust. RESEARCH_PROMPT.md sections 16/19 require continuing after unfavorable results; section 10 priority 8 adversarial audits done. The remaining unfinished half of section 3.2: do funding-conditioned features predict OBSERVED liquidation intensity (Track A)? This campaign executes it.

hypotheses.H_primary: Funding-conditioned features (signed funding, abs funding, premium, EMA distance, trailing RV) incrementally predict observed liquidation intensity (hourly event count and OI-normalized notional) beyond the RV-only baseline, on non-overlapping forward blocks, with leakage-hardened design.
hypotheses.H_null: Funding-conditioned features add no incremental forecast skill over the RV-only baseline for observed liquidation intensity; any apparent association is leakage, survivorship, or incomplete-label artifact.

identity_map: liquidations.market 'XXX-PERP' (and prefixed variants like 'xyz:KIOXIA-PERP') -> coin 'XXX' by stripping suffix after the last '-PERP' and any exchange prefix before the first ':'; join to candles_1h/funding/open_interest on coin + UTC hour. Delisting-aware: a coin is eligible at hour h only if it has a valid candle row at h; exited coins (no final-window coverage) form a separate sensitivity arm, never merged into survivors.

targets.primary_count: observed liquidation event count per coin-hour (wallet-level events deduped by tx_hash within the hour)
targets.primary_notional: OI-normalized observed liquidation notional intensity = sum(notional_usd) / open_interest_usd per coin-hour
targets.secondary_occurrence: binary indicator of >=1 observed liquidation in the coin-hour (Brier/log-loss calibration)
targets.construction_window: outcome measured over the forward 24h window t+1..t+24h; all predictors from data ending no later than t

features.C1_funding_aug: B1 + signed funding rate + abs funding percentile (train-only 90-day lookback)
features.C2_funding_plus_dislocation: C1 + mark/index premium + mark/EMA24 distance (train-only standardized)
features.scaling: training-only means/stds; zero-variance columns -> constant 0; missing features remain missing (never zero-filled)

splits.unit: one eligible linear perpetual coin x one fully closed UTC hourly timestamp
splits.test: distinct hourly timestamps after the 48h purge+embargo, grouped into non-overlapping 168h forward blocks; an origin is admitted only if its full 24h forward window fits inside one block
splits.block_bootstrap: per-coin block bootstrap resampling complete UTC time blocks jointly across coins, seed 20261122, 2000 replicates

materiality_rule: materiality_met iff relative QLIKE/Poisson-deviance reduction of C2 vs B1 <= -2.0% (C2 at least 2% better than B1); floor is FROZEN and never relaxed after outcomes
primary_metric: paired out-of-sample QLIKE difference (C2_vs_B1) and Poisson deviance difference on observed intensity targets, reported as absolute and relative %; secondary: Brier score, log loss, calibration slope/intercept for occurrence
multiplicity: Holm familywise correction across the declared family {C2_vs_B1_primary_count, C2_vs_B1_primary_notional, survivors_arm, exited_arm}; report raw and Holm-adjusted p; whole family disclosed

alpha_spending.rule: alpha_k = 0.05/(k*(k+1)) for k=2 => 0.05/6 = 0.008333; sequential confirmatory look k=2 (RESEARCH_PROMPT.md section 17)

decision_rule: SUPPORTED iff materiality_met AND bootstrap CI95 upper bound < 0 AND Holm-adjusted primary p < alpha_2; PARTIAL_POSITIVE_SIGNAL iff incomplete labels prevent a full census but directional signal is consistent; NOT_SUPPORTED otherwise. Nulls preserved honestly; never claim a complete observed-liquidation census from a capped feed.
admissibility: RESEARCH_PROMPT.md section 15: observed-liquidation coverage/completeness audited BEFORE any outcome is inspected; capped-sample check; missing events are NOT zero; incomplete-label design declared if completeness cannot be supported
software: stdlib + pyarrow only; numpy/pandas/scipy not used; no network; no new source; no overlay
independent_recompute: fclr_risk09_recompute_20261122T224500Z.py (independent stdlib recompute from stored input hashes)
